notes.content:
A camera that rotates around the course has been added (8 keys).
Add camera auto-switching mode (period (.) key) key)
Course is drawn on the title screen.
Fixed some bugs in editing.

Keyboard shortcut for gazing at the ball is changed to 0.
Toggle gazing at the ball by pressing the 0 key.
Fix/unfix next point when editing control points.
Changed the button for adding parts in edit mode.

Steam Workshop support
Added keyboard shortcut for switching camera in View Mode
Added a camera to view the ball from a fixed point.
Fixed a bug that sound does not work in View Mode.

notes.title: update 1.0.1
notes.content:
Font changes. Addition of Japanese. Addition of setting dialog.
Removed flickering when riding in an elevator.
Side view and backward view in View Mode can be operated.
(W,S key and cursor key).
Changed the clip plane of the camera.
Other bug fixes. Improved operability.
